cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You wrapped tape round that chair leg, so I've taped this loose one. Sit on it before I use it for dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My tape marks where to cut. It isn't holding anything together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, marking the weak point. You can test how it holds while I watch the tape.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll steady the back for you. Just put a little weight on the seat first; I'll only take my turn once you've stood up again.

reason: Show borrowed confidence as a specific misunderstanding, then preserve the actual pursuit through B's corrections, solutions or conditions.
